name: United Arab Emirates
description: The United Arab Emirates is a federal monarchy of seven emirates on the Arabian Gulf's southern shore. Since federation in 1971, oil wealth has funded diversification into finance, aviation, logistics and tourism, with Dubai and Abu Dhabi as global hubs. Its open, expatriate-majority economy pairs sovereign-wealth investment with ambitious technology and energy-transition bets.

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal mapping of the Emirati actor space from pearling and trading dhow networks through oil-concession state-building to sovereign wealth funds, flag carriers, and free-zone regulators.

works.title: Oil-to-Finance Diversification Network
works.description: Network analysis of national oil companies, sovereign portfolios, aviation groups and fintech licensing drawing Gulf surpluses into global assets.

works.title: Emirate Federal Structure
works.description: Geospatial representation of seven emirates' uneven endowments, federal-supreme-council bargaining, and port-airport urbanism along the Gulf coast.
